```{r}
#uploading the data
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(skimr)
library(moderndive)
```

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fivethirtyeight/data/master/college-majors/recent-grads.csv"

college_major_data <- read_csv(url)

college_major_data <- na.omit(college_major_data)

view(college_major_data)
```

```{r}
#visualizing the data
college_major_data %>% select(Median) %>% skim()

#histogram of response variable
ggplot(college_major_data, aes(x=Median)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill="lightpink", color="black", bins = 30) + 
  labs(title = "Distribution of Median Salary Across Majors", x="Median Salary", y="Frequency")
```

```{r}
ggplot(college_major_data, aes(x=Major_category, y=Median)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "blue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of Salary by Major Category",
       x = "Major Category",
       y = "Median Salary")

#is this helpful visually?
```

```{r}
# Boxplot by Category to identify variations[cite: 9]
ggplot(college_major_data, aes(x = reorder(Major_category, Median), y = Median)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Salary Distribution by Major Category", 
       x = "Category", y = "Median Salary ($)")
```
```{r}
simple_model <- lm(Median ~ ShareWomen, data = college_major_data)
summary(simple_model)
```


```{r}
multiple_model <- lm(Median ~ ShareWomen + Unemployment_rate + factor(Major_category), 
                     data = college_major_data)
summary(multiple_model)
```

```{r}
#Stepwise Model Selection
model_empty <- lm(Median ~ 1, data = college_major_data)
model_stepwise <- step(model_empty, direction = "both", 
                       scope = ~ ShareWomen + Unemployment_rate + Major_category + Total)
```

```{r}
#Model Assumptions
plot(model_stepwise, which = 1, col = "blue") 
plot(model_stepwise, which = 2, col = "green")
plot(model_stepwise, which = 4, col = "red")
```

```{r}
#Colinearity
vif(model_stepwise)
```

```{r}
#Nested Model Comparison
anova(simple_model, model_stepwise)
```
